main_text.head: VIRIS NOBILIBVS ET EXIMIIS, INSIGNI PIETATE, virtute, doctrina, & sapientia claris, Consulib. & Senatoribus Reipublicæ Stadensis, Dominis, fautoribus & Patronis suis observandis.

p.i: ARtium bonarum non est tenuis usus & obscura utilitas in Ecclesia, curia, & Oeconomia. Sanè homines priuati, qui vel characteres literarum formare calamo, & expedire rationes mediocriter norunt, in metallica, mercatura & similibus negocijs magna dexteritate versantur. Nec minus ijdem juvantur anni cognitione ex diarijs, & mensuris, quam Astronomia & Geometria acceptâ debemus. Quanto autem, uberiores fructus copiosior doctrina præbet, in gravioribus studijs, religionis, & juris ciuilis? Quæ necessaria sunt, ne extinguatur notitia Dei inter homines, Sed ut seruetur Ecclesia & multi fiant hæredes vitæ æternæ, & custodiatur disciplina,

main_text.notes: The initial "A" is a large woodcut initial (decorated letter) and is read as "A" joined to "Rtium", giving "ARtium". The first word of the paragraph is set in roman capitals with the initial. Some words are uncertain due to the ornate italic type and the transparent tape covering the right edge; no marks were found to be unreadable. Catchword not visible. Mid-page text ends with "disciplina," at the foot of the text block.
